name: infocallouts-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 9 simple rung for the `infoCallouts` flag (simple tier — on in both modes). Enters the room editor and asserts the 'Designing one room' `.info-callout` (id=room-editor) is mounted, screenshots it, dismisses it via its close button and asserts it never re-mounts on a fresh enterRoomEditor call (persisted dismissal), then enters the floor-plan editor and asserts its DIFFERENT `.info-callout` (id=floor-plan) still shows (per-id dismissal, not a global switch), then flips the flag off directly and asserts the floor-plan callout unmounts even though it was never dismissed, and restores it back on to confirm it reappears (still dismissed by id where applicable — a fresh id 'floor-plan' was never dismissed so it comes straight back).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: infoCallouts should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: assert-room-editor-callout-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.info-callout'); if (!el) throw new Error('Expected the room-editor .info-callout to be mounted'); if (!/Designing one room/.test(el.textContent||'')) throw new Error('Wrong callout content: ' + (el.textContent||'')); })()

steps.name: dismiss-room-editor-callout
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.info-callout .ic-dismiss'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'.ic-dismiss' button not found"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-callout-gone
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.info-callout')) throw new Error('Expected .info-callout to unmount after dismiss'); })()

steps.name: assert-callout-stays-dismissed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.info-callout')) throw new Error('room-editor callout should stay dismissed across a fresh enterRoomEditor call'); })()

steps.name: assert-floorplan-callout-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.plan-screen .info-callout'); if (!el) throw new Error('Expected the floor-plan .info-callout to be mounted (a different id than room-editor, so its own dismissal is independent)'); if (!/Editing your floor plan/.test(el.textContent||'')) throw new Error('Wrong callout content: ' + (el.textContent||'')); })()

steps.name: assert-floorplan-callout-hidden-by-flag
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.plan-screen .info-callout')) throw new Error('Expected .info-callout to unmount once infoCallouts is turned off (never dismissed, only flag-gated)'); })()

steps.name: assert-floorplan-callout-reappears
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.plan-screen .info-callout'); if (!el) throw new Error('Expected the floor-plan .info-callout to reappear once infoCallouts is restored'); })()
